title: Headless lanes guard Fable billing and log model fallbacks
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/advisor-and-model-features-2026-11-16.md: in `-p` and Agent SDK sessions Claude Code never asks consent for Fable usage-credit billing; safety-classifier fallbacks move a session to Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 and it stays there (PostModelSwitch hook event).
Outcome: headless lane sessions (`krn lane run`) set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` unless the lane brief opts in, and a PostModelSwitch hook appends the from/to model to the lane's run log; `krn doctor --hooks` lists the hook as wired (exit 0).
Why: unattended lanes must not spend Fable credits silently or finish on a weaker model unnoticed.
Proof: a lane-run test asserts the env var in the spawned session; a hook test with a captured PostModelSwitch payload writes one log line.
Files: src/cli/lane-run.ts, src/hook/, test/hook/
